newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials drift lower, run out of steam.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials drift lower, run out of steam.

text.p: U.S. blue chips ran out of steam in late morning and drifted slightly lower, unable to sustain an early rally ahead of the Federal Open Market Committee meeting in Washington Tuesday.

"There was just a sense of disappointment that the market could not hold in, and there is a little bit of nervousness about tomorrow's Fed meeting," said Peter Coolidge, senior equity trader at Brean Murray & Co.
The Dow was off 2.09 points at 692.57.
Nasdaq was down 4.43 points or 0.28 percent at 1557.60.
The long bond was up 6/32 to yield 6.53 percent.
The market was expected to remain in a holding pattern and perhaps drift slightly lower until the outcome of the FOMC meeting was known, Coolidge said.
Nevertheless, most analysts expected the Fed to leave interest rates unchanged this time round.

Meanwhile the price of Amylin Pharmaceuticals Inc's stock fell 6-3/8 to 8-1/2. Everen Securities said it cut its rating on Amylin to underperform, citing disappointing Phase III results of its candidate drug for diabetes.
